generators.carrier: finite clock Z/d with declared root tau, tau^2 = omega

relations.statement: ZX = omega XZ on the finite clock with tau^2 = omega; even d needs a declared 2d-th root so labels are not reduced mod d
relations.hypotheses: finite dimension d, declared root of unity

relations.statement: A finite characteristic-zero CCR [X,P]=iI is refused: tr[X,P]=0 but tr(iI)=i*d is nonzero, whether or not the finite Weyl relation holds

lemmas.statement: No finite-dimensional characteristic-zero matrices X,P satisfy XP-PX = cI for c nonzero
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem no_fin_ccr {n:Nat} (hn: 0<n) (X P : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Rat) (c:Rat) (hc:c≠0) : X*P-P*X ≠ c • (1:Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Rat) := by sorry

lemmas.statement: The finite Weyl relation does not imply a CCR on a completed real line; the two are distinct claims

near_misses.claim: The finite Weyl relation ZX=omega XZ is a CCR on a completed real line
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Nonzero exact trace of the identity in finite dimension refuses a characteristic-zero CCR

near_misses.claim: For even d, reducing labels modulo d preserves the Weyl phase
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: A sign is dropped; a declared 2d-th root is required
